EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key = 'wlm_context', @value = 'adhoc_query';

EXECUTE AS User = 'analystUser'
SELECT
patient.gender AS Patient_Gender,
patient.maritalStatus_text AS Patient_Marital_Status,
SUM(claim.total_value) AS Sum_Of_Claim_Total_Value,
COUNT_BIG(claim.total_value) AS Count_of_Claims
FROM fhir.patientIdentifier AS patient
INNER JOIN fhir.patientSeverePainMV observation
ON patient.patient_id = observation.patient_id_reference
INNER JOIN fhir.claimMain AS claim
 ON patient.patient_id = claim.patient_id_reference
WHERE
--claim.billablePeriod_start >= '01-01-2020 00:00:00' AND claim.billablePeriod_start < '12-31-2021 00:00:00'
claim.year = 2020
GROUP BY
patient.gender,
patient.maritalStatus_text
ORDER BY
patient.gender,
patient.maritalStatus_text 
OPTION (LABEL = 'data_analytics')
REVERT

drop view fhir.patientSeverePainMV ;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW fhir.patientSeverePainMV  
WITH (distribution = hash(patient_id_reference), FOR_APPEND)  
AS
SELECT
patient_id_reference
FROM fhir.observationMain main
INNER JOIN fhir.observationCode code
ON main.observation_id = code.observation_id
WHERE
code.code_text = 'Pain severity - 0-10 verbal numeric rating [Score] - Reported'
AND main.valueQuantity_valueInt between 8 and 10
GROUP BY patient_id_reference;

select top 100 * from fhir.observationMain where valueQuantity_value is not null;

select top 100 * from fhir.patientSeverePainMV;
